name: agentarmy-local-embedder
description: Local embedding service — function-tier image generating dense vectors for ArcadeDB RAG. Exposes the embeddings slice of the LLM-gateway contract (OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/embeddings) so callers swap between cloud embed and local embed transparently. CPU baseline via sentence-transformers + BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (384-d, L2-normalized). OpenVINO / Intel Arc iGPU acceleration is a follow-up — the CPU path works on any architecture sentence-transformers supports. Hub issue #184 is the model-serving pin.

shims.note: torch CPU wheel pulled from download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu. Model selection via EMBEDDER_MODEL env (default: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5, 384-d). HF cache pre-created with embedder-user ownership so the named volume mount preserves write access (Docker initializes named volumes by seeding from the image's existing path content + ownership).

baked.purpose: FastAPI app: POST /v1/embeddings (OpenAI-compatible) + /livez + /readyz + /healthz. Lazy-loads the model on first request; sync .encode() runs in the default executor so the event loop stays unblocked.
5-check doctor: warmup triggers lazy load; /healthz surfaces model_loaded:true; POST returns embedding; vector dim matches MODEL_DIM; L2 norm finite + non-zero.

doctor.description: Warmup POST triggers lazy model load; /healthz reports model_loaded=true with declared embedding_dim; POST /v1/embeddings returns a vector of that dim with finite, non-zero L2 norm. Verified locally: 5/5 PASS with BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (dim=384, L2=1.0 normalized).

deploy.notes: Different hardware profile from spokes (NPU / iGPU candidate) is the load-bearing ADR-023 split rationale. Co-locate near ArcadeDB to keep RAG latency low.

contract.note: PLANNED — embeddings.openapi.yaml is backlog row BE-4. Until the spec lands, the embedder implements the embeddings slice of contracts/llm-gateway.openapi.yaml (POST /v1/embeddings, the EmbeddingRequest/EmbeddingResponse schemas).
